question: Who is the chairperson of Paris Cité University?

new.passage: The Academic Senate of University of Paris, meeting on 8 October 2019, elected Edouard Kaminski, vice-president for research, Philippe Roussel-Galle, vice-president for training.

subject: Q48844389
question: Who is the chairperson of Progressive Slovakia?

new.label: Michal Šimečka
new.passage: Progressive Slovakia (Progresívne Slovensko, PS) is a liberal and social-liberal political party in Slovakia established in 2017. The party is led by Michal Šimečka, a former Vice President of the European Parliament. It is a member of the Renew Europe group and is a full member of the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe Party.

old.label: Irena Bihariová
old.passage: Progressive Slovakia  is a social-liberal, progressive, pro-European political party in Slovakia established in 2017. In present is party chairwoman human rights activist Irena Bihariová. Tomáš Valášek is only one parliamentary deputy of Progressive Slovakia in National Council, he left parliamentary group of centrist party For the People.

subject: Q170424
question: Who is the chairperson of World Meteorological Organization?

new.label: Abdulla Al Mandous
new.passage: Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the WMO is governed by the World Meteorological Congress, composed of member states, which meets every four years to set policies and priorities. The Congress is led by an Executive Council led by the President, currently Abdulla Al Mandous of UAE.
